regime_context: The Canadian market is led by Big Banks with strong trend and full breadth but high crowding. Rotation is broad, no single narrative dominates. The absolute-trend gate historically helped cut drawdowns, but forward edge is limited. Macro backdrop is AI/geopolitical-heavy with high unscheduled news flow, adding event risk.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper — watch for durability exceeding 0.6 and breadth above 0.5, which would signal a durable trend capable of challenging leadership; kill if rank slips below 5 or theme loses eligibility.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks hold the top rank, full breadth, high durability, and trend eligibility—the themes best aligned with the validated drawdown-control edge. Crowding flags a sizing caution, not a fade; this is a trend-following overweight, not an alpha call.
theses.dissent: Elevated crowding raises the risk of a sharp reversal on any bank-specific shock such as disappointing earnings or a credit event.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO loses eligibility or its durability bar falls below 0.5.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities show broad participation (0.846), decent durability (0.66), and no crowding. Trend gate eligibility supports lower-drawdown behaviour, and while score is moderate, the structure favours trend persistence.
theses.dissent: Rising bond yields would hurt rate-sensitive utilities, and the mixed Hurst exponent signals possible trend instability.

falsifier.text: Breadth falls below 0.5 or XUT.TO loses eligibility.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: The theme has a negative score, low durability, and a mean-revert tag—trend‑following arguments support avoidance. Poor breadth (0.385) and no crowding mean no reflexive squeeze risk, and the trend structure is unfavourable.
theses.dissent: A defensive rotation in a macro shock could revive the sector; mean‑reversion may trigger a snap‑back rally.

falsifier.text: Score turns positive and durability surpasses 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
